course.title: Industrial Management
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: An engineer designs a system consisting of two subsystems in series with the reliabilities (09) R1 = 0.99 and R2  0.85 respectively. The cost of the two subsystems is approximately the same. The engineer decides to add two redundant components. Which of the followings is the best to do?
i) Duplicate subsystems 1 and 2 in high-level redundancy.
ii) Duplicate subsystems 1 and 2 in low-level redundancy.
iii) Replace the second subsystem by a three component parallel system.
